Problems found and fixes applied:
- body_mass_g was stored as text (e.g. "3,750"); cast to numeric so it could be summed.

- Adelie = Adelie (43,525) + adelie (4,000) + Adeile (3,300) = 50,825
- Chinstrap = Chinstrap (32,000) + Chinstrap " (3,800) + Chinstarp (3,900) = 39,700
- Gentoo = Gentoo (87,300) + Gentoo " (10,950) + Gentto (5,250) = 103,500
